title: Standing firm in trials as commanded
body: Hezekiah 3:16 commands believers to stand firm in every trial, so wavering in hardship is direct disobedience to Scripture.

title: Praying for the dead in Esdras and Maccabees

title: Dunamis means dynamite power
body: Romans 1:16 says the gospel is the power of God. The Greek word is dunamis, where we get dynamite, so the gospel is literally explosive dynamite power that blows up sin.

title: Tithing guarantees wealth
body: Malachi 3:10 proves that God guarantees financial riches to everyone who tithes faithfully. If you are poor, it is because you lack faith or have not given enough.

title: Must I obey my grandmother's dream

title: God helps those who help themselves

title: Forgiveness and kindness in Ephesians

title: Charity means donations
